Following the November 2022 flood event, Council worked with the community to develop a Recovery Plan The Plan outlines the measures that both Council and the community are taking in response to the flood event and breaks down estimated costs to repair critical infrastructure throughout the Cabonne Shire The plan also breaks down estimated costs for repairs to local homeowners, businesses, the natural environment, and the wellbeing of local communities The Cabonne Recovery Plan is also helping drive our direction to restore the Cabonne Local Government Area in partnership with Council, the community, disaster support agencies, and state and federal government
